column1: # bioinfo reference store manifest  --  SOURCE OF TRUTH for /refs
# Every pipeline config refers to STANDARD paths only (never raw source filenames).
# Moving to a new machine: edit the SOURCE column, re-run bootstrap/04-refs.sh, done.
# columns: standard_path <TAB> mode <TAB> source <TAB> note <TAB> sha256
#   link   symlink into SOURCE. Zero copy. Use for sequential-read files (FASTA, GTF, BED, JSON).
#   copy   materialize into ext4. Use for random-access-heavy files where /mnt/d I/O hurts.
#   build  generated locally by a tool. SOURCE is the command hint. Never symlinked.
#   fetch  must be downloaded. SOURCE is the URL or nf-core param that pulls it.
# sha256: optional, read by bootstrap/04-refs.sh --verify. Blank means nobody has
#   hashed that file yet, which is not an error. Fill it with 04-refs.sh --hash,
#   never by hand. Directories (trailing /) and unfetched entries stay blank.
# SOURCE uses WSL paths. Windows D:\ is /mnt/d.
